name: 1 BHK (35-50 m²)
note: A starting point, not the answer. Source: target_area values calibrated to the p50 (p50-p75 for larger flats) of room areas in municipal-approved Mumbai plans, see planner_engine/data/mumbai_approved_stats.json (50 projects, 655 pages); min_area stays at the DCPR 2034 / office floors. Foyer is optional and the entry falls back to the living room: in approved Mumbai plans the front door opens straight into the living room in 73% of flats whose entrance room is named, and a named foyer is the entrance in 0.4% (mumbai_topology_priors.json, entrance.room_type; n=1,797 flats, 48 projects). The toilet is attached to the bedroom (not the living room): master-toilet is a door link in 87% of approved flats that have both (n=374, 15 projects) and a single toilet is next to the sleeping room in 62% of 1BHK flats (n=603, 38 projects), against living-toilet 12% (n=825, 41 projects).
